paragraphs: A typical day follows a check, ready, launch, and recover rhythm. Before a mission, inspect the catapult and arresting cables. During launch, hold your flight deck position, signal on command, and confirm every step. During recovery, watch the landing closely. As soon as the aircraft stops, secure it, release the cable, and move it off the deck. After a full cycle, your ears are filled with engine noise and your mind stays intensely focused.
